articles.title: Could the galaxy's coldest 'stars' actually be giant alien power plants?
articles.summary: Scientists think some super-cold objects in space might not be stars at all—they could be huge structures built by aliens to collect energy. A new study shows how we could spot them with telescopes like the James Webb.

articles.title: SpaceX's giant Starship booster roars to life in a fiery 25-second test
articles.summary: SpaceX fired up all 33 engines on its newest Super Heavy booster in Texas, a major step toward the next Starship launch. The test lasted 25 seconds and could lead to a flight as soon as July 15.

articles.title: Europe's most active volcano might be one of a kind—here's why
articles.summary: Mount Etna in Italy erupts all the time, but scientists never knew how it formed. A new study says it might be a rare type of volcano that grows from tiny magma pockets squeezed up by moving tectonic plates.
